questionText: Which of the following protocol pairs can be used to send and retrieve e-mails (in that order)?
explanation:
Sending E-mails: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is used to push/send e-mails from a client to a server or between mail servers.

Retrieving E-mails: Post Office Protocol version 3 (POP3) or Internet Message Access Protocol (IMAP) is used to pull/retrieve e-mails from a mail server.

Therefore, the pair used to send and retrieve e-mails in that order is SMTP and POP3.
